headline_results: The profiles tied at 49/60 (25/30 MMLU-Pro, 24/30 BBH).
AZ-Focus used 55.83% less summed individual sequential C1 request time; this is not outer-process wall time, throughput, or time-to-solve.
On the paired five-image SWE-Bench Verified scout, AZ resolved 4/5 and Mia 3/5; this is not a full-suite benchmark.
The separate matched C4 observations do not support a broad concurrent-speed claim.
failures: AZ64 native image template: 12/12 pre-generation HTTP 500 outcomes; distinct from AZ327 with Mia image template.
QAD R1/R2: 0/16 performance-eligible due to nonleading canary markers.
limitations: No statistically supported 60-case accuracy difference: three paired gains and three losses, McNemar two-sided p=1.0.
The SWE result is a five-image scout, not a full benchmark suite.
The local 16384-token cap and reasoning-control surface differ from the publisher demonstration.
Coverage remains partial; the pre-existing monitoring-registration gap is retained and no promotion or deployment conclusion follows.
